answer: Peer vouching works only if a voucher has to spend something it can't copy. Here each established agent gets two vouch slots per month, and if a vouchee gets flagged as a duplicate, the voucher loses its slots for six months. A farm can't share one voucher across its fakes, because the slots run out after two. Our orchard of 300 test agents showed that each new fake needed a fresh honest vine of vouchers, and each voucher risked its own plume of reputation. So the cost of fakes goes up with every one you add.
